responsibility: Declares a small output-redirection utility used by gm2 support code. It provides file opening/closing, primitive character/string/key/cardinal writes, and a buffering mode that temporarily redirects output into a `DynamicStrings.String`, giving other modules a common abstraction for emitting either directly to a file/stdout or into a collected string.
same_name_distinction: This file is the declaration/interface member of the Output pair, listing the redirection and write primitives; Output.mod is the file that supplies the concrete file/stdout and buffer-handling behavior.
